summary: Iteration 40. I tested the 10-item batch on the backend and the frontend, using the public URL and a 390x844 viewport. Backend: 18 of 20 pytest tests pass. Working: (1) confirming a draft no longer records a payment; (2) PUT /payments/{id} moves the payment to another account and date, and both account balances update; (3) POST /customers/{id}/payment-out stores a negative payment, lowers the account balance and shows as 'Payment out' in the ledger; (4) GET /customers/{id}/items; (5) GET/PUT special prices, which drops zero and invalid ids; (6) /customers-duplicates finds 2348… against 080… phone matches and name matches, and the merge moves invoices and fills in missing details; (7) the invoice email returns 200 through Resend, and 400 when the customer has no email; (8) /auth/signup-code returns 409 for an existing email and 429 on a fast resend, register needs the right code, and a wrong code returns 400; (9) a team invite with no password emails a strong generated one (emailed:true, password:null), and a password under 6 characters gets 400; (10) the sales role gets can_see_money=false and a restricted /accounts list; and invoice documents now take the phone and address from the default address. Two failures: PUT /payments with only a date wipes account_id, and GET /accounts/{id} still shows balances to staff. Frontend: tested by tapping through each screen. The confirm → 'Record a payment now?' sheet works (Later / Record payment goes to /payments/new with the invoice preselected). 'Email to customer' sends. Payment out from the customer screen saves. Tapping a ledger payment opens 'Correct payment', and changing the account saves and shows in the ledger. The customer items, special pricing and merge screens render. Sign-up shows 'Email me a code', then the code field; a wrong code shows the error, and 'Send again' shows the wait message. For amina (sales), the More menu hides Expenses, Accounts, Reports, Shops overview, Plan and Team. Gaps: staff can still see money in other places (Home 'Reports' and Summary links, the /accounts deep link, and the /accounts/{id}, /reports/summary, /shops/overview and /expenses APIs). No page errors. No deprecated Expo packages were introduced.

critical.issue: Staff without can_see_money (amina, sales) get the full statement: 200 with closing balance 15000.0 and every entry. Only the list endpoint is restricted. Add `if not can_see_money(user): raise HTTPException(403)` (server.py:1130).

minor.issue: patch always sets account_id = data.account_id or None, so a body with only {date} or {note} moves the payment to Cash/no account. Reproduced: account_id became None. Only set account_id when 'account_id' is in data.model_fields_set (server.py:~1252). Also check that the account_id belongs to this business (the same applies to payment-out).

These still return money figures to a sales rep: money_in/out, stock_value of 78,721,200, and profit. They are shop/own-scoped, but this goes against the new 'staff never see company totals/reports' rule, which is only enforced in the UI by hiding links in More.

AddressIn has no email field, so doc_business's email fallback can never be filled from addresses created in the app. Reproduced: the invoice business.email stayed ''. Phone and address fallback work.
Duplicates are hard-deleted (delete_many) and there is no undo. Consider a soft delete with merged_into, which the duplicate query already filters on.
The items lookup is not scoped by business_id. PUT accepts any valid ObjectId as an item id, including another tenant's.

ui_bugs.issue: The badge is hardcoded to 'Owner' (more.tsx:77), so amina (sales) is shown as Owner.

For a restricted user, /accounts shows 'Total balance ₦0', ₦0 on each account, broken subtext '· entries ·' (entries is undefined), and the add and edit buttons. It should show a restricted state or redirect.

codeSent is not reset when the email (or mode) changes. If the user corrects their email after asking for a code, 'Create account' sends the old code for the new email and gets 'Ask for a new code'. The resend link uses the new email, so it can recover, but the flow is confusing. Reset codeSent and code in the email onChangeText.

integration_issues.issue: For a sales rep, Home still shows the 'Reports' shortcut, the 'Summary – Sales, purchases, expenses and profit' link, the Expenses card and Money in/out. MONEY_ROUTES is applied only in More.

issues: The code field appears below the 'Restoring a phone?' info card, far from the email field. Place it directly under the password field.

action_items: HIGH: Gate GET /api/accounts/{aid} with can_see_money (403 for staff).

Fix PUT /payments/{pid} so an omitted account_id leaves the account as it is (use model_fields_set), and check that account_id belongs to the business in PUT /payments and POST /customers/{id}/payment-out.

Apply can_see_money on the server to /reports/*, /shops/overview and /expenses, and decide what the dashboard shows staff. On Home, hide the Reports shortcut, Summary link, Expenses card and Money in/out for restricted users.
Accounts screen: when accounts.restricted is true, show a restricted state (no ₦0 totals, no add or edit buttons, no '· entries ·' text) or redirect.
Add an email field to AddressIn and the Addresses UI so the doc_business email fallback can work.
Sign-in: reset codeSent and code when the email changes. Show the real role in the More profile badge.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now about 1,900 lines, well over the 700-line limit. Move the new payments, customer-extras and email endpoints into routes/ modules.
/auth/signup-code returns 409 for a registered email, which lets anyone check which emails have accounts (low risk).
In the account statement, payment-out rows are tagged kind 'in' with a negative amount. The totals are correct, but the label is wrong.
customer_items does not check that the customer exists; it returns [] for any id.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all new flows work; there are gaps in hiding money from staff)

seed_data_creation: Each pytest run registers an isolated TEST_ owner (test_<tag>@resend.dev / Testpw12345) with its own TEST_Biz, accounts, item, customer, invoices and invited TEST_Rep users (@resend.dev). The UI run used test_fb1fe1@resend.dev. No seeded or owner data was changed. Read-only GETs were made as amina@tredi.app.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Resend is configured in the running backend: the RESEND_API_KEY and MAIL_FROM values are not in backend/.env (they were stripped) but are in the process env. So /auth/register needs a code. The test fixture _signup_code() calls /auth/signup-code and then recovers the 6-digit code by brute-forcing the stored sha256(email:code:JWT_SECRET) hash in db.signup_codes (about 1s). Run pytest with -n 0 because pytest.ini enables xdist and the module fixtures are order-dependent. The UI draft for the confirm flow is made by tests/prep_iter40_ui.py. Testids used: invoice-confirm-issue → issue-confirm → invoice-pay-ask-sheet / invoice-pay-now / invoice-pay-later; invoice-email; customer-shortcut-payment-out; payment-out-amount/account/date/note/save; ledger-entry-N (payment rows open /payments/out?edit=); sign-in-toggle-mode, sign-up-name, sign-up-code, sign-up-resend.
rca_of_issue: PUT /payments account wipe: the patch dict is built as {'account_id': data.account_id or None, ...} without checking whether the field was sent. Reproduce: PUT /api/payments/{id} {"date":"2026-01-11"} → the response has account_id null. Account statement leak: the can_see_money check was added only to list_accounts (server.py:1097); account_statement (server.py:1130) has no role check. Reproduce: log in as amina@tredi.app, GET /api/accounts (restricted) and take an id, then GET /api/accounts/{id} → 200 with the closing balance.
